units.name: 专项测验
units.title: A Day in the Life 日常作息与时间表达专项测验
units.desc: 针对人教版2024新教材七年级上册 Unit 6 A Day in the Life 的高难度变式测验，覆盖日常活动词汇、时间表达法、Wh- 疑问句，以及关于不同国家青少年日常作息的跨文化阅读语篇。

options: A. get up; have breakfast
B. go to bed; have breakfast
C. get up; have lunch
D. go to school; do homework
exercises.question:
— What do you usually do in the morning?
— I ______ at 6:30 and ______ at 7:00.
exercises.explanation: 句意为：——你早上通常做什么？——我6:30起床，7:00吃早饭。get up（起床）和 have breakfast（吃早饭）都是早晨的活动。B 中的 go to bed 是晚上，C 中的 have lunch 是中午，D 中的 do homework 通常是傍晚或晚上。故选 A。易错点：混淆不同时间段的日常活动。

exercises.answer: a quarter to eight; half past nine
exercises.question:
用英语写出下列时间（使用逆读法）。
7:45 → ______    9:30 → ______
exercises.explanation: 7:45 表示差一刻八点，逆读法为 a quarter to eight；9:30 表示九点半，逆读法为 half past nine。考察时间表达法的逆读规则：分钟数 > 30 时用 to，分钟数 ≤ 30 时用 past。

options: A. What time; What
B. When; What
C. What time; When
D. What; What time
exercises.question:
— ______ does your father go to work?
— He goes to work at 7:30.
— ______ does he do after work?
— He usually exercises.
exercises.explanation: 第一空根据答语 at 7:30 可知，询问具体时间点，用 What time 或 When 均可，但 What time 更精确；第二空根据答语 He usually exercises. 可知，询问活动内容，用 What。结合选项，A 最佳。易错点：混淆 What time 和 What 的用法。

exercises.question:
用括号中所给动词的适当形式填空。
My sister ______ (brush) her teeth at 7:00. Then she ______ (go) to school at 7:30.
exercises.explanation: 主语 My sister 是第三人称单数，一般现在时中动词要用第三人称单数形式。brush 变为 brushes，go 变为 goes。考察一般现在时第三人称单数的动词变化。

options: T
F
exercises.question: 在句子 'I get up at six in the morning.' 中，'at' 和 'the' 通常需要重读。
exercises.explanation: 在英语句子中，实词（如 get, up, six, morning）通常重读，虚词（如 at, the）通常弱读。故本题错误。考察句子重音规则。

options: A. What time do you get up?
B. What do you do in the morning?
C. When do you go to school?
D. Do you get up early?
exercises.question:
— ______
— I usually get up at 6:30 and have breakfast at 7:00.
exercises.explanation: 答语描述了早晨的一系列活动（get up and have breakfast），因此问句应是询问早晨的活动内容，用 What do you do in the morning?。A 询问具体起床时间，答语只需回答一个时间点；C 询问上学时间；D 是一般疑问句，回答用 Yes/No。故选 B。逆向思维：根据答语反推问句。

options: T
F
exercises.question:
阅读 Emily 的学校日介绍，判断下列句子是否正确，正确写 T，错误写 F。
Hi, I'm Emily from Australia. I get up at 7:00 in the morning. I have breakfast at 7:30. School starts at 8:30. We have four classes in the morning. I have lunch at 12:30. In the afternoon, we have two classes. School ends at 3:30. After school, I play netball with my friends. I go home at 5:00. I do my homework from 6:00 to 7:00. I have dinner at 7:30. I go to bed at 9:00.
(1) Emily is from the UK. (2) Emily has lunch at 12:30. (3) Emily plays netball after school. (4) Emily goes to bed at 10:00.
exercises.explanation: 由 Hi, I'm Emily from Australia. 可知(1)F；由 I have lunch at 12:30. 可知(2)T；由 After school, I play netball with my friends. 可知(3)T；由 I go to bed at 9:00. 可知(4)F。考察阅读细节提取与跨文化语境理解（澳大利亚的 netball 是一项特色运动）。

options: A. What time do you get up?
B. What do you do after that?
C. When do you go to bed?
D. Do you get up early?
E. What time do you have breakfast?
exercises.question:
Choose TWO correct sentences to complete the dialogue.
— Hi, Mike. 1. ______
— I usually get up at 6:30.
— 2. ______
— I have breakfast and go to school.
exercises.explanation: 第一空：根据答语 I usually get up at 6:30. 可知，问句是询问具体起床时间，A 符合；第二空：根据答语 I have breakfast and go to school. 可知，问句是询问起床后的活动，B 符合。C 询问睡觉时间，D 是一般疑问句，E 询问吃早饭的具体时间（答语应为时间点，而不是活动）。考察 Wh- 疑问句与交际语境的综合。

exercises.question:
找出并改正下列句子中的错误（时间介词误用）。
I get up at 6:30 on the morning. I go to bed at 10:00 in night.
exercises.explanation: 在早上用 in the morning，而不是 on the morning；在夜里用 at night，而不是 in night。原句两处介词错误：on the morning 应改为 in the morning，in night 应改为 at night。考察时间介词的准确搭配。

exercises.question:
阅读短文，用适当的词填空。
My name is Peter. I am a student in London. I usually ______ (1) (get) up at 7:00. I have breakfast at 7:30. Then I go to school at 8:00. School ______ (2) (start) at 8:30. I have lunch at 12:00. In the afternoon, I have two classes. School ______ (3) (end) at 3:30. After school, I often play football. I go home at 5:00. I do my homework from 6:00 to 7:00. I have dinner at 7:30. I go to bed at 10:00.
exercises.explanation: 第一空主语 I，动词用原形 get；第二空主语 School 是第三人称单数，start 加 -s 变为 starts；第三空主语 School 是第三人称单数，end 加 -s 变为 ends。考察一般现在时第三人称单数的动词变化与语篇综合理解。
